follow-up time: Until death or the end of the study period (2012-2017)
cohort: The study included 56 pregnant women with uncorrected congenital heart disease, most of whom had atrial septal defect.
finding: Severe pulmonary hypertension, Eisenmenger syndrome, and reduced right ventricle systolic function were associated with increased maternal mortality in pregnant women with uncorrected congenital heart disease.
